title: Astronaut UFO code names per Edgar Mitchell

tellings.quote: fascinating. This guy in Japan said that they had uh he spoke he was close with Edgar Mitchell as well and he said that they had um code names according to Edgar Mitchell.

plain: NASA astronauts had secret code names for UFOs, according to Edgar Mitchell, the Apollo 14 astronaut who walked on the Moon. Michels says he heard this from a man in Japan named Takano Josen, who was close with Mitchell and passed on what Mitchell told him. So the claim comes to Michels third-hand, and if true it would mean astronauts saw UFOs often enough to need a private way of talking about them.
